_about: Translation cases for D6 (tests/d6_translation_eval.py), Arabic and English in both directions. Checks are computed in the test: recognised as a translation; in the right language; every number, date and code of the source present; nothing dropped at the end; the bank's terms used; layout kept; no citation or page marks; and, from the service's report, source and translation aligned paragraph by paragraph.

cases.about: An Arabic policy sentence into English: limits, days and job titles.
cases.q: ترجم للإنجليزية: يعتمد مدير الفرع العمليات حتى 1,000 جنيه، والعمليات من 1,000 إلى 2,000 جنيه يعتمدها مدير المنطقة، وتُسوّى عهدة المصروفات النثرية خلال 5 أيام عمل من نهاية كل شهر.

cases.about: English banking terms into Arabic: the bank's own terms must be used.
cases.q: Translate to Arabic: The customer must complete the KYC form before the letter of guarantee is issued; a standing order cannot replace a direct debit, and the IBAN must match the beneficiary name.
